actual_gap.gap: The four currently required methods have useful learned/practice/application loops, but their authored Frontier practice is capped at mastery four, and the configured drill refuses practice at mastery four. There is no selected continuing mature use for one chosen method that proves simple competence can keep changing meaningful function at extraordinary levels. This is a content/application gap in the bounded prototype, not a missing universal progression engine: authored practice has no global mastery ceiling, typed progression tracks/receipts and five distinct power execution models already exist.
actual_gap.selected_scope: Only required after a world/career explicitly selects a method for continuing exceptional growth. No universal cap or level curve is selected for all abilities.
actual_gap.original_connected_case: Proposal: keep Trail Reading's current ordinary crossing route. A later authored upper application could use the same drainage method to plan a heavy rescue litter route in a chosen Frontier chapter; increased mastery changes which usable bank/load route the player can prepare, then affects a real work order or rescue outcome. Offer a costly mentor/field observation route and a steady level-alone route if that world's rule permits either; if the crossing campaign has no such mature application, explicitly abstain and keep the current four-tier prototype.
actual_gap.alternatives_and_abstention: Use continuous method mastery, an authored action threshold, an insight/teaching transition, or a small hybrid, selected per method. Do not force replacement sources, rare items, random failure, creator ranking or extra prestige as universal gates. No sixth skill, new ledger or runtime extension is warranted where existing mastery and authored consumers suffice.

If a selected branch, benchmark, or persistent source lineage adds durable state, choose additive migration/default and old-reader behavior before release. packet.qualitative_cost: Low to medium for a single authored extension within present seams; high if it expands into reusable benchmark/branch history or broad pacing UI. Balance and maintenance rise with many independent mastery curves.
packet.deferred_acceptance: On a rebuilt browser, show the same method's early and mature command changing its named functional outcome; verify costs, native XP/stock/participant owner, preview/blocked state, interruption/cancellation, reload/revisit, and one ordinary alternative. Human review decides whether the growth feels earned and the chosen career is still useful.

actual_gap.gap: A selected campaign with temporary form, permanent body change, unique organ, lineage inheritance or body-bound source needs an explicit carrier-transition consumer. Existing scalar body facts and source acquisition records do not restore a temporary form, bind/release an organ, or reconcile an active channel when its supporting body/pool disappears. The `alternate_body` traveler mode is a detached preview explicitly marked `nativeExecutable:false`; the native traveler adapter currently profiles one existing player body for physical passage only.

actual_gap.original_connected_case: Proposal: in a future body-changing world, a temporary glider form enables one elevated route interaction; removing it restores the same body and preserves trained skill, while a separately installed wing organ remains with its actual carrier. A soul-bound learned procedure may persist; body-anchored balance and its physical fuel do not silently migrate. Offer a safe ordinary rope route and abstain from the transformed route if support is unavailable.
actual_gap.alternatives_and_abstention: For one chosen effect, author a fixed local temporary-form boundary or an explicit anchor on existing source/custody records. Do not create a universal anatomy simulator, infer lineage from a label, give copies donor anatomy/pools/items, or add recurrent physiology ticking unless a selected world has a concrete consumer.

actual_gap.gap: The saved Lio/Mara contest proves native integration and one genuine guard function; it is deliberately hard-coded to one rival, one helper, one protected player, one redirect target and voluntary nonlethal conclusion. It does not establish a general objective-driven hostile battle with opponent plan, actual contact/target legality, counter, retreat/rescue/cargo outcome or unequal-power special means. Deterministic actor controllers already exist for registered world commands; calling all actor AI or party combat absent is false.
actual_gap.selected_scope: Optional until a specific world story selects a hostile or objective combat scene and its defeat/injury/legal policy. The broader attack-everyone option, lethal rules, offline strikes and generalized roster are not accepted by this audit.
actual_gap.original_connected_case: Proposal: one named road antagonist maintains a real wind screen while two people carry a survey kit. The player can use trained trail knowledge to take an ordinary safe approach, interrupt the supported screen with one authored counter, or escort the kit around the fight. The enemy can change target to the actual carrier when contact is known. Each choice settles only the real injury/cargo/pursuit result; superior defense may simply block an unsupported attack.
actual_gap.alternatives_and_abstention: For a small authored scene, use the existing sequenced encounter executor if turn-based results suffice; use nativeBattle only if actual native Combat timing/bars are part of the intended behavior. Keep one selected policy for target legality/replanning. Abstain from a universal battle AI, full faction war, realtime hidden planning or universal immunity/rank tables.
